title: hydrocotyle novae-zeelandiae var. involucrata
intro: Hydrocotyle novae-zeelandiae var. involucrata, commonly known as New Zealand pepperwort, is a plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to New Zealand and Australia. Research suggests that the plant has potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Hydrocotyle novae-zeelandiae var. involucrata include its ability to act as a nervine tonic, anxiolytic, and sedative, which may help to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic effects.
